display.purpose: Hero and chapter headlines set large against quiet fields.

body.purpose: Vietnamese trip narrative and profile messages.

label.purpose: Dates, indices, route labels, and image credits.

motion.name: chapter-reveal
motion.purpose: Bring chapter copy and images into view without overshooting.

motion.name: scroll-parallax
motion.purpose: Move scene photography subtly with document progress.

motion.name: intro-exit
motion.purpose: Lift the monochrome wordmark intro out of view.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Stack chapter layouts and use mobile reveal choreography.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Reduce navigation density on narrow phones.

breakpoints.name: pinning
breakpoints.purpose: Enable pinned chapter title and desktop pointer movement above this width.

components.name: MIYO Wordmark
components.description: Compact typographic signature used in the hero navigation and closing footer.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { color: #f7f7f5; font: 700 30px/.9 'Space Grotesk', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.11em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark span { color: #a5a5a2; } .ds-wordmark:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Journey Link
components.description: Underlined, text-first action that moves from the opening image into the trip narrative.
components.html: Đi qua hành trình ↓
components.css: .ds-journey-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 22px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.78); color: #f7f7f5; font: 400 12px/1.5 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; text-decoration: none; transition: gap .25s ease; } .ds-journey-link:hover { gap: 34px; } .ds-journey-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Timeline Marker
components.description: Small outlined point connecting a chapter label to the editorial timeline rule.
components.css: .ds-marker { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border: 1px solid #0a0a0a; border-radius: 50%; background: #f7f7f5; }

components.name: Scroll Progress
components.description: A quiet two-pixel line that communicates position through the long-form story.
components.css: .ds-progress { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 2px; background: rgba(10,10,10,.16); } .ds-progress span { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; transform: scaleX(.42); transform-origin: left; background: #0a0a0a; }

narrative.overview:
The /memories/ surface treats the exchange trip as a sequence of cinematic pauses: a single image or typographic scene earns the space, while the interface stays quiet. The visual language is editorial and tactile rather than decorative, using paper-like off-white, near-black fields, grayscale photography, fine rules, and a subtle grain texture.

Scroll is the narrative mechanism. Chapters progress through restrained reveals, image parallax, and a pinned desktop title; mobile keeps the same story but avoids pinning. This system documents the implemented memories surface and should not be assumed to describe unrelated site routes.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome scenes with a deliberately limited set of illustrative photographs.
Oversized, tightly composed display type balanced by readable Vietnamese body copy.
Flat surfaces, hairline rules, and motion that follows the trip narrative.

rules.name: The Grayscale Rule
rules.body: Keep photography monochrome and do not introduce a decorative accent hue; use tonal contrast to distinguish chapters.

rules.name: The Headline Rule
rules.body: Favor short, deliberate line breaks and modest negative tracking; allow Vietnamese words to wrap without clipping at narrow widths.

dos: Do preserve the monochrome photo treatment, broad scene crops, and strong light/dark chapter changes.
Do keep Vietnamese body text readable at 14px or larger and retain the 11px metadata treatment for genuinely secondary labels.
Do keep desktop pinning and parallax conditional on motion preference; use normal-flow chapter reveals on mobile.
Do keep profile content conditional on the QR/profile data and maintain the direct navigation links.
donts: Don't rebuild the page as a dense photo collage or a grid of rounded cards.
Don't add color accents, heavy shadows, or decorative UI that competes with the trip scenes.
Don't make meaning depend on motion; reduced-motion users must retain the complete story without pinning or scroll animation.
